import json, subprocess, sys
import numpy as np
import check

def run(reqs):
    data = ("\n".join(json.dumps(r) for r in reqs)+"\n").encode()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=data,capture_output=True,timeout=300)
    return p.stdout.decode().splitlines(), p.stderr.decode()

cases = []
def add(name, req): cases.append((name, req))

# budget exactly binding: flows must equal the baseline
add("budget 0 forces baseline", {"epoch":1,"node_count":2,
  "edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":10},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":10}],
  "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":20,"paths":[[0],[1]],"previous":[8,8]}],
  "failed_edges":[],"budget":0})
# budget 0 but baseline infeasible -> infeasible
add("budget 0 baseline wrong", {"epoch":2,"node_count":2,
  "edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":10},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":10}],
  "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":20,"paths":[[0],[1]],"previous":[16,0]}],
  "failed_edges":[],"budget":0})
# optimum exactly at the ceiling
add("mlu exactly 1", {"epoch":3,"node_count":2,
  "edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":10}],
  "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":10,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]}],
  "failed_edges":[],"budget":0})
# mlu above the ceiling -> infeasible
add("mlu above 1", {"epoch":4,"node_count":2,
  "edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":10}],
  "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":11,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]}],
  "failed_edges":[],"budget":0})
# capacity split, tight capacity
add("tight capacity split", {"epoch":5,"node_count":2,
  "edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":5},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":5}],
  "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":10,"paths":[[0],[1]],"previous":[16,0]}],
  "failed_edges":[],"budget":0})
# demand change scaled by current demand
add("demand change", {"epoch":6,"node_count":2,
  "edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":100}],
  "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":50,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]}],
  "failed_edges":[],"budget":0})
# failed edge forces migration
add("failed edge forces migration", {"epoch":7,"node_count":2,
  "edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":100},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":100}],
  "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":50,"paths":[[0],[1]],"previous":[16,0]}],
  "failed_edges":[0],"budget":0})
# same source/target pair twice
add("repeated pair", {"epoch":8,"node_count":2,
  "edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":100}],
  "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":10,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]},
                  {"source":0,"target":1,"demand":20,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]}],
  "failed_edges":[],"budget":0})
# budget with room to move
add("budget room", {"epoch":9,"node_count":2,
  "edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":100},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":100}],
  "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":50,"paths":[[0],[1]],"previous":[16,0]}],
  "failed_edges":[],"budget":25})

lines, err = run([r for _, r in cases])
if err: print("stderr:", err[-1500:])
bad=0
for (name, req), line in zip(cases, lines):
    resp=json.loads(line)
    errs = check.check(req, resp)
    d = check.build(req)
    if resp["status"]=="optimal":
        y=np.array(resp["dual"]["inequality"]); q=np.array(resp["dual"]["equality"])
        acc=d["A_ub"].T.dot(y)+(d["A_eq"].T.dot(q) if d["A_eq"] is not None and d["K"] else 0)
        viol=float((acc-d["c"]).max())
        L=float(d["b_ub"].dot(y))+(float(d["b_eq"].dot(q)) if d["A_eq"] is not None and d["K"] else 0)
        extra="viol=%.3g |y|=%.4g |q|=%.4g gap=%.3g mlu=%.6g" % (viol,np.abs(y).max(),np.abs(q).max() if len(q) else 0,abs(resp["mlu"]-L),resp["mlu"])
    else:
        y=np.array(resp["certificate"]["inequality"]); q=np.array(resp["certificate"]["equality"])
        acc=d["A_ub"].T.dot(y)+(d["A_eq"].T.dot(q) if d["A_eq"] is not None and d["K"] else 0)
        val=float(d["b_ub"].dot(y))+(float(d["b_eq"].dot(q)) if d["A_eq"] is not None and d["K"] else 0)
        extra="viol=%.3g |y|=%.4g norm=%.10g" % (float(acc.max()),np.abs(y).max(),val)
    status = "OK " if not errs else "FAIL"
    if errs: bad+=1
    print("%s %-32s %-11s %s %s" % (status, name, resp["status"], extra, errs if errs else ""))
print("bad",bad)
PYEOF
